description: This file defines the LinkFormatter class for rendering link fields in Drupal, including configuration, URL building, and rendering logic.

classes.name: LinkFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for formatting link fields with customizable settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LinkFormatter with dependencies.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the formatter.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the formatter settings.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of the current formatter settings.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates the renderable link elements based on field items.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a Drupal URL object from a link item, applying settings.
